easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
